# Sales and partnerships

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py. Edit the YAML source, not this file. -->

**Department id:** `sales`  
**Mission:** Sell what exists to customers who need it, with evidence-based forecasts and counsel-reviewed terms.

## Startup stage

Founder-led sales with a written ICP, stage definitions and a proposal template. The CRM can be a spreadsheet; the discipline cannot be skipped.

## Agents operating in this department

`sales-specialist`, `growth-lead`

## Roles
